verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents only a single thin mention of 'exception tracking and error analysis', plus service-level error-rate monitoring. An AI use case for investigating what changed after a deploy loosely touches release context. None of these describe issue grouping or the other specific elements of the story. Missing for 10: evidence of errors grouped into issues, stack trace views, release/version tracking, regression detection, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
